method: Port of ANALYSIS/OPENSWATH/TargetedSpectraExtractor except searchSpectrum (needs AccurateMassSearchEngine) and storeSpectraMSP (needs the MSP writer; its two preparation steps are ported). The class-test sections that do not need MSP libraries are transcribed with their literals and TEST_REAL_SIMILAR tolerance; the target list is built in the test from the class test's CSV for the fields the class reads.
evidence_tier: tier 1 (executed differential: 8 cases, 2682 records, Linux x86_64 Release install openms4-release-bc9cc12-c19e494-174b576 on ibminode06: target list as TransitionTSVFile reads it, annotateSpectra, pickSpectrum under three settings, scoreSpectra with features, selectSpectra at three thresholds, extractSpectra, BinnedSpectrumComparator with matchSpectrum); tier 3 (class-test literals: parameters, pickSpectrum, annotateSpectra both overloads, scoreSpectra both overloads, selectSpectra both overloads, extractSpectra both targeted overloads, mergeFeatures, annotateSpectra with MS1 features, constructTransitionsList, storeSpectraMSP's peak removal); tier 4 (matching with a fixed-score comparator, BinnedSpectrumComparator self-match and option parsing, Rust-only refusals)

fixtures.role: The class test's target list; the test builds the equivalent TargetedExperiment from it (TransitionTSVFile is not ported)
Records of ../oracle/O4b-tse/driver.cpp (results/oracle.tsv), byte-identical across two runs

oracle.sdk: Linux x86_64 Release install /ceph/ibmi/abi/oliver/opt/openms4-release-bc9cc12-c19e494-174b576, x86_64-conda-linux-gnu-g++ (conda-forge gcc 14.4.0-4) 14.4.0, flags -O3 -DNDEBUG -std=gnu++23 -fPIC -fvisibility=hidden -fvisibility-inlines-hidden -mssse3 -ffp-contract=off -fopenmp
oracle.environment: env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME=<run>/home OPENMS_HOME_PATH=<run>/home OPENMS_DISABLE_UPDATE_CHECK=ON OPENMS_DATA_PATH=<install>/share/OpenMS/4.0.0 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
oracle.reproduction: remote_run.sh runs the driver twice in fresh processes; records, stdout, stderr and exit code were byte-identical (results/differ.txt empty).
oracle.comparison: Names, counts, annotation coordinates and selection membership exactly; values computed through smoothing, picking and noise estimation within 1e-9 relative (absolute below 1e-9), a bound fixed before the first run.
oracle.measured: Linux x86_64 (spock), stable and 1.85.0: all 4832 floating values bit-identical; the test-side target list equals TransitionTSVFile's on every transition name, peptide reference and precursor m/z and every peptide retention time and unit (598 records).

external_reference_note: The C++ driver and its run script live outside this repository under ../oracle/O4b-tse so that no C++ is committed here. results/hashes.txt records the sha256 of the driver, the two inputs, the built driver, libOpenMS.so and the oracle output as they were on ibminode06.

class_test_review.comparison: TEST_EQUAL exact; TEST_REAL_SIMILAR as isRealSimilar with absdiff 1e-5 and ratio 1 + 1e-5.
class_test_review.not_transcribed: matchSpectrum, targetedMatching, untargetedMatching and the MS1-feature extractSpectra section load MSP files through MSPGenericFile; the searchSpectrum section runs AccurateMassSearchEngine; storeSpectraMSP's file round trip needs MSPGenericFile::store.
